title: Ankhorage Legend State Adapter
summary: Adapts Legend State to Ankhorage state contracts.
purpose: Provide a dedicated state implementation boundary so consumers use Ankhorage state contracts rather than Legend State directly.
responsibilities: Implement Ankhorage state contracts with Legend State.
Expose the adapter through the package public entrypoint.
boundaries: Does not define the shared state contracts.
Does not own application-specific state models or persistence policy.
audience: Applications selecting Legend State as their state implementation.
useCases: Use Legend State through an Ankhorage state adapter.

architecture.role: Provider adapter at the state-contract boundary.
invariants: Legend State remains isolated behind the package adapter boundary.

limitations: Only state behavior represented by the shared contract is portable to consumers.
